Disclaimer

  1. General Scope and Limitations of Inspection:
    • Scope of Inspection: Car C.I.D. provides a detailed visual and operational inspection of the vehicle based on the conditions present at the time of inspection. The inspection includes, but is not limited to, an assessment of the vehicle’s exterior, interior, engine, transmission, electrical systems, and other accessible components. The inspection report reflects the condition of the vehicle as observed during the inspection and is not a guarantee of future performance or reliability.
    • Non-Exhaustive Examination: The inspection performed by Car C.I.D. is limited to the accessible and visible parts of the vehicle. Certain areas, components, and systems may not be inspected due to inaccessibility or manufacturer design. For example, components covered by protective panels or those that require disassembly to access are excluded from the inspection.
    • No Guarantee on Hidden Defects: The inspection may not uncover hidden defects, issues that are not visible without special equipment, or problems that could develop after the inspection. Car C.I.D. does not provide assurances against future defects or malfunctions.
  2. Non-Diagnostic Nature of the Service:
    • Inspection vs. Diagnostic: The inspection is not equivalent to a mechanical diagnostic service. Car C.I.D. does not perform tests or use equipment to diagnose internal engine conditions, computerized systems, or transmission integrity unless otherwise specified in the service agreement.
    • Specialized Testing Excluded: The inspection does not include emissions testing, fluid analysis, or in-depth electronic control module scanning. These require specialized tools and services beyond the scope of a typical car inspection.
  3. Limitation of Liability:
    • Report Accuracy and Use: The inspection report is intended solely for the use of the client and represents the opinion of the inspector at the time of the inspection. Car C.I.D. shall not be liable for any discrepancies, inaccuracies, or errors in the report resulting from external factors such as weather, lighting conditions, or modifications made to the vehicle after the inspection.
    • No Warranty on Vehicle Condition: Car C.I.D. does not provide any warranty, either express or implied, on the condition, performance, or safety of the inspected vehicle. The client assumes all risks associated with the use of the report and the purchase or use of the vehicle based on the report findings.
  4. Exclusions and Exemptions:
    • Title and Registration Issues: The inspection does not include verification of the vehicle’s title, registration, or ownership history. Car C.I.D. does not check for liens, encumbrances, or legal issues associated with the vehicle.
    • Compliance and Legal Use: The report does not confirm compliance with local, state, or federal regulations, including but not limited to safety standards, emissions regulations, or other legal requirements.
  5. Price Estimation
    • Please note that the estimated price range provided is not an accurate indicator of the car's market value. It is subject to multiple factors, including market trends, demand, location, and individual buyer or seller conditions. This estimate should not be considered a legal or final price.
  6. Client Responsibilities:
    • Verification and Use of Report: It is the client's responsibility to verify the findings of the inspection report and use it in conjunction with other assessments, such as a mechanic’s evaluation or a title search. Clients should not rely solely on the Car C.I.D. report to make a purchase decision.
    • Prompt Review of Findings: Clients should review the report promptly and address any questions or concerns with Car C.I.D. within a reasonable timeframe after receiving the report.
  7. Payment and Service Terms:
    • Payment Obligation: Full payment for the inspection service is due upon completion of the inspection and delivery of the report. Non-payment may result in withholding the report or legal action to recover owed amounts.
    • Cancellation and Rescheduling: Clients must notify Car C.I.D. of any cancellations or rescheduling requests at least 24 hours in advance. Failure to do so may result in a cancellation fee.
  8. Dispute Resolution:
    • Governing Law: Any disputes arising from the inspection service or the report will be governed by the laws of the Indian Government.
    • Arbitration Agreement: By using Car C.I.D.’s services, the client agrees to resolve any disputes through binding arbitration, the same shall be referred to a sole arbitrator who shall be appointed by the Company. The proceedings shall be conducted in the English Language under the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, and the courts of Delhi shall have sole jurisdiction over the matter and/or for the enforcement as the case may be.
  9. Changes to Disclaimer:
    • Modification Rights: Car C.I.D. reserves the right to modify these terms and disclaimers at any time without prior notice. Any changes will be posted on our website and will become effective immediately upon posting.
  10. Contact Information:
